SELECT status, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(invoiced), 2), ROUND(SUM(paid), 2),
       ROUND(SUM(balance_due), 2)
FROM (SELECT i.customer_id, i.status, i.total_amount AS invoiced, COALESCE(p.paid, 0) AS paid,
       i.total_amount - COALESCE(p.paid, 0) AS balance_due
FROM cube_demo.erp_invoices i
JOIN cube_demo.erp_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(amount) AS paid
           FROM cube_demo.erp_payments GROUP BY invoice_id) p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id)
WHERE customer_id = 26
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
